speaker: richard_burbage
text: Hold the pieces up. Whoever has the bean is king tonight, and my mother will not have the king chosen twice.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have not swallowed it. Here it is.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we have a king. Thou hast played queens since thou wast eleven, Nick, and this is the first time the crown is thine.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A boy king. Marry, I have served worse. What is the tax, Majesty? I mean to talk.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Three decrees, if the hall will hear them.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Hear him. He sits straighter than I do.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: First. Master Kemp shall keep silence the length of a paternoster.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Begin it, then. I am not afraid of a prayer I can finish.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Amen, by'r lakin. A clown's breath was not built for the whole of it. That was half, and I know half when I have spent it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Half the prayer, Master Kemp. The decree stands. You did not keep it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Put the failure where my name stands first, on the Greenwich paper. The Admiral's men are at Greenwich again tonight. Let them have the cold chamber. I do not mind them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody minds. We had a holiday yard at two, and the yard was full. I do not envy a man a presence-chamber tonight.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Second. Master Heminges shall say no Item till morning.

speaker: john_heminges
text: That is hard law, sir. I will try it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Third. Sam shall have the last slice.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Leave him the slice, then. Thou hast governed a table, Nick. King for the first time, and already poorer by a silence.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Twenty-one years, and two to run.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Drink, Father. The spice is at the bottom.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The holiday boxes cleared eleven pound eight shillings, to the sharers' side, without a drum or a trumpet.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Master Heminges. The decree.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the gallery on Saturday—

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: You said it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Off with the slice. The king has a slice to give, and the king should give it before the rest of us improve the law.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: One slice of your cake, Master Heminges, for Sam. Not a penny. A slice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Paid, and not entered. Sam, it is yours. I will not say the word again tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eleven pound eight, to the sharers' side. I am not taking it home as mine. John said it. Nick has fined it. That is the money I mean to remember.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then remember the cake. Thou art a guest, Will. My mother has gone back to the knife. She does not make speeches.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I lasted half a prayer, and I do not mind Greenwich. If that is kingship, Majesty, you may have it. I am going back to talking, which is my trade.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Two to run. I have said it. Cuthbert has moved the jug. Let the boy eat.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Sam has the last slice. The decrees are done. I am king until the plate is clear, and then I am Nick again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then be king until the plate is clear. I played at two. I am not playing him at this table.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: The jug is by him. Leave the lease where he put it, and leave the boy his slice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eleven pound eight. I have said it once, and the Item after it has already cost me. I am done.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Done is a good end to a feast. The yard was full. The cake has a king. I am content.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am content. Nobody minds Greenwich. The money is the sharers' side, and Sam has the slice.
